info.title: WhiteMatterTech Feed API
info.summary: RSS 2.0 feed of posts published on whitematter.tech.
info.description: The site's syndication feed, regenerated at build time by Hugo. Intended for feed readers and automated agents that poll for new posts. There is no authentication and no rate limiting.

get.description: Returns the most recent posts as an RSS 2.0 document.

schema.description: RSS 2.0 XML. The channel contains one item per recent post, each with title, link, pubDate, and description.
